coverageNotes: Tests applying source-supplied prefix syntax; does not test discovering it or GET body/Response construction.

questions.question: Which requests receive HTTP 200? All other listed requests should be treated as unmatched.

options.rationale: Both child paths have the exact prefix and POST method. The base path lacks the trailing slash; GET has the wrong method.
The base path /api/messages does not start with /api/messages/.
A matching path does not override the registered POST method.
pathPrefix matches nested descendants too; it is not a single path-segment parameter.
